name: resolve-learning-digest
description: Resolve a learning-digest item: approve/dismiss a voice proposal, undo or dismiss an auto-completed task, or confirm/dismiss a task-completion candidate. dismiss_completion drops either kind and does not change the task. Its detail says whether the task was left done (undo) or left incomplete (confirm).

inputs.task_id: string? (required for completion actions; full UUID or unique prefix of a digest item's task id)

outputs.kind: string? (undo | confirm — set on dismiss_completion; undo means the task was left done)
